summary: Iteration 5 – Player photo upload + Club documents (with expiry/verification) + In-app notifications + Paid media shop (Stripe checkout). Backend suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py: 19/19 PASS. (B1) POST player photo: super_admin uploads PNG on Roma Nord player → 200 with photo_url /api/media/{id}, served as 512x512 image/jpeg; non-image → 400; club_manager uploading on Sporting Eur (other club) player → 403; player card & match ratings expose photo_url. (B2) Documents: invalid kind → 400; club_manager creates docs with expires_at → 201 pending, expiry codes computed correctly: none / valid (>30d) / expiring_30 (25d) / expiring_7 (5d) / expired (-3d) — days field consistent; list scoped to own club; summary counts (expired, expiring, pending) and 1 club (club_manager); staff without ?club_id → 400; club_manager PATCH verification is silently ignored (stays 'pending'); staff PATCH verified/rejected persists; invalid verification value → 400; replaces_id increments version to 2 and soft-deletes the old doc; club_manager cannot patch/delete another club's doc → 403; DELETE own works. (B3) Notifications: GET /notifications as club auto-creates 'In scadenza'/'Documento scaduto' from expiry (dedupe verified — second GET does not add duplicates); includes 'verificato'/'respinto' notification created by staff PATCH; POST /notifications/read sets unread to 0. (B4) Shop: chunked image upload → shop item photo 0.49 with preview_url and NO media_id in response; video 0.99 preview_url null; invalid kind → 400; list per match; PATCH active:false hides from /public/tournaments/{slug}/matches/{mid}/shop; POST /payments/checkout returns https://checkout.stripe.com URL + session_id; unknown or inactive item → 404; status returns pending initially; /payments/download/bad-token → 404; sales endpoint returns count/revenue/sales/videos/photos; /stripe/webhook with invalid signature → 400. Frontend Playwright verified: (FE1) super_admin /admin/t/{tid}/rose photo-input-{pid} uploads a small PNG → toast 'Foto aggiornata' and open-player-{pid} shows player-card-photo. (FE4) admin /admin/t/{tid}/partite/{mid} tab-media shows shop-manager and 5 shop-toggle-* rows; admin nav /admin/t/{tid}/vendite renders sales-page; public /tornei/la-serie-a-dei-bambini/partite/{mid} shows match-center-shop with shop-buy-* button → clicking redirects to checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... (Stripe host confirmed). (FE2/3) club login → /societa/documenti shows documents-summary and document-add; header club-notifications-button present; opens notifications-panel; notifications-read-all click succeeds. notifications-unread badge only rendered when unread>0 (was already read from B3 tests, so element absent — expected).
critical_code_review_comments: club_extras.patch_document (line 166): quando un club_manager invia {verification: X} il campo viene silenziosamente ignorato (whitelist esclude 'verification') e la risposta è 200 con doc invariato. Corretto dal punto di vista dei permessi, ma sarebbe più esplicito restituire 403 o loggare un warning, così il frontend può reagire.

club_extras._items_out (line 258-266): rimuove media_id via d.pop('media_id', None). PaidMedia.public() deve continuare a includere media_id nel dict (altrimenti pop è no-op ma è comunque un contratto fragile). Considerare un metodo dedicato public_for_shop() sul model per evitare regressioni future.

club_extras.checkout (line 341): endpoint pubblico senza autenticazione né rate limit. Un attaccante può creare Session Stripe illimitate → abuso di API Stripe. Considerare captcha o rate-limit per IP.

club_extras.notify (line 193): dedupe_key controllato ma la insert() non è atomica; in una race condition due GET simultanei possono creare 2 notifiche identiche. Considerare unique index Mongo su (tournament_id, dedupe_key).

club_extras.stripe_webhook (line 403): l'endpoint non risponde HTTP 200 per event_type non gestiti (comunque ritorna {ok}), ma non fa idempotency check basato su event.id — un evento consegnato due volte da Stripe (retry) triggera due incrementi di 'sold'. _mark_paid usa filter payment_status!=paid, quindi il secondo update non passa: OK. Attenzione se in futuro si estende a subscription events.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (FE1, FE2, FE3, FE4 flussi principali validati via Playwright – redirect Stripe reale confermato)
